description: Purpose of this region: complaints and grievances raised by people, with their current status.
content:
This region records what members or visitors have complained about.

Belongs here: what was raised, by whom, when, and how it was answered or resolved.

Does not belong here: technical faults with no human complaint behind them — those go to scope.site_development or scope.site_security. A complaint that leads to a decision should link to the entry in scope.org_decisions rather than repeat it.
